correctness.rationale: The right branch is absorbing since mu-delta>1; indefinite left pseudo-orbits must remain in delta/(k-1) of zero by back-substitution. For first high index N choose exact entry b in [1,k) delta-close to x_N: if x_N<k use b=x_N, otherwise choose b near k from below. Backward left expansion and forward right contraction give a convex-bound by the maximum of 1/(k-1) and 1/(1-lambda). Constant pseudo-orbits at epsilon/(k-1) and r-epsilon/(1-lambda) give independent sharp bounds as epsilon increases to delta. At lambda=0, k=2, mu=2-lambda, branches and boundaries remain valid. Independent exact-rational finite-prefix tests corroborated 22 accepted cases, without claiming infinite proof.
